title: Manhunt system
body:
# 🧭 Manhunt System Datapack

A lightweight and flexible manhunt system designed for instant gameplay.  
No mods, no plugins — just drop it in and the game starts automatically.

---

## 🚀 How It Works
- When the world loads, a **30‑second automatic countdown** begins  
- No role selection required — the game starts on its own  
- Players who join **after the countdown** will automatically become **Spectators**  
- Every time the world reloads, the system **resets and starts a new countdown**

---

## 🔧 Features
### ✔ 100% Vanilla Commands
Runs entirely on vanilla functions. No mods required.

### ✔ Automatic Start
The game begins 30 seconds after world load.  
Perfect for servers or quick sessions where you want zero setup.

### ✔ Spectator Handling
Late‑joining players are placed in **Spectator Mode** to keep the game fair.

### ✔ No Auto-Ending
This datapack intentionally **does not** include a fixed win condition.  
Ideal for any manhunt style:

- Reach the Nether  
- Defeat the Ender Dragon  
- Time‑limited challenges  
- Custom rulesets  

You decide how the game ends.

### ✔ Lightweight & Fast
Minimal overhead and smooth performance even on low‑spec servers.

---

## 🎯 Ideal For
- Servers that want a fully automated manhunt start  
- Content creators who need a simple, reliable base system  
- Players who prefer defining their own win conditions  
- Worlds where the player does not reload or restart

---

## 📦 Notes
- It only works in multiplayer mode.
- Automatically resets on every world load  
- Compatible with most datapacks that don’t override game‑start logic

---

## 📝 License
Feel free to use this datapack in videos, streams, or servers.  
Credit is appreciated but not required.
